mapper.sql: FROM support_ticket t INNER JOIN chat_session s ON s.id = t.session_id INNER JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = s.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_user a ON a.id = s.agent_id

where.if: AND ( CONCAT('TK-', LPAD(t.id, 8, '0')) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR s.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR t.description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR t.resolution LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') )
AND (a.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.agentKeyword}, '%') OR a.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.agentKeyword}, '%'))

mapper.select:
SELECT CONCAT('TK-', LPAD(t.id, 8, '0')) AS ticket_no, t.session_id, t.status, s.priority, s.category, s.title, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.nickname, ''), u.username) AS user_nickname, COALESCE(NULLIF(a.nickname, ''), a.username) AS agent_nickname, t.created_at, t.updated_at
ORDER BY t.updated_at DESC, t.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}

SELECT t.status, COUNT(*) AS count
GROUP BY t.status
